Keywords.Boing: When this unit is activated, you may place all models with this rule in it anywhere within D3+1" of their position.
Keywords.Bombing Run(X): Once per activation, when this model moves over enemy units, pick one of them and roll X dice. For each 2+ it takes 3 hits with AP(1).
Keywords.Destructive: This model may move through enemy units. Whenever it does, pick one of them and roll one die. On a 4+ it takes 3 hits with AP(1).
Keywords.Instigator: Once per this unit's activation, before attacking, pick one other friendly unit within 12", which may move by up to 6".
Keywords.Power Shrooms: Once per this unit's activation, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to hit next time it fights in melee.
Keywords.Shaman Circle: Pick one model in this unit to have Caster(X), where X is the total number of models with this rule in this unit. If the model is killed, pick another to be the new caster, and transfer all spell tokens to it. The caster loses all unspent spell tokens at the end of the round.
Keywords.Surprise Attack(X): This model counts as having Ambush, and may be deployed up to 1" away from enemy units. Once deployed, roll X dice. For each 4+ one enemy unit within 3" takes 2 hits with AP(1).
Keywords.Takedown: Once per game, when this model attacks in melee, you may pick one model in the unit as its target, and make 1 attack at Quality 2+ with AP(1) and Deadly(3), which is resolved as if it's a unit of 1.
Keywords.Warning Cry: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model.

Goblins Army Spells.Spider’s Might (1): Target 2 friendly units within 12" get Poison next time they fight in melee.
Goblins Army Spells.Glare (1): Target enemy unit within 12" takes 1 hit with AP(2) and Deadly(3).
Goblins Army Spells.Nuisance (2): Target 2 friendly units within 12" get +1 to defense rolls next time they take hits.
Goblins Army Spells.Death Shroud (2): Target enemy unit within 12" takes 4 hits with AP(2).
Goblins Army Spells.Sneaky (3): Target 2 friendly units within 12" move +3" next time they Advance, or +6" next time they Rush/Charge.
Goblins Army Spells.Curse (3): Target enemy unit within 18" takes 1 hit with Blast(12).
